"Dark Dreams of Furiae"
Developed by Silverstring Media
and Phantom Compass

Dark Dreams of Furiae is a new fantasy RPG module for Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition. The characters and events of this module coincide with the official Dungeons & Dragons tabletop campaign, Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus.   

Designed and Directed by: Lucas J.W. Johnson
Written by: Jacob Burgess and Lucas J.W. Johnson
Additional Design by: Claris Cyarron
2D Art by: Anna Wolff
Music by: Devin Vibert
Intro VO by: Jacob Burgess
Scripting and Area Design by Phantom Compass
Additional Scripting by Paul Caporicci / Creative Bytes Studios
Medieval City Tileset by Zwerkules
Additional Custom Content by Symphony
